A person who is intensely interested in a particular field or hobby and often having limited or nonstandard social skills. Often used with an attributive noun.
d.x: I was a complete computer geek in high school, but I get out a lot more now.

d.d: An expert in a technical field, particularly one having to do with computers.
d.x: My laptop’s locked up again. I need a geek.

d.d: The subculture of geeks; an esoteric subject of interest that is marginal to the social mainstream; the philosophy, events, and physical artifacts of geeks; geekness.

To enthusiastically engage in geek-like or nerdy interests.
d.x: It was our first time at a Star Trek convention and we had an amazing time wandering around and geeking.
